name: io.github.mandymozart/qr
title: qr: QR codes that never expire
description: Free dynamic QR codes that never expire: retarget later, styles, scan stats. No API key needed.

tools.name: create_qr_code
tools.description: Create a dynamic QR code for a link. The code never expires and its target can be changed later. Returns the short URL, PNG/SVG image URLs and the QR image. Without an API key it also returns an edit_url: give that to the user, it is their only way to change the code later.

target_url.description: Full http(s):// URL the code should open

style.description: Optional look. Dark colors only; every style is test-scanned.

dots_color.description: Custom hex color like #1f4fd8 (must be dark)

emoji.description: Emoji in the middle (Twemoji code point), e.g. 1f3a8 = 🎨, 1f3b8 = 🎸, 1faa9 = 🪩

tools.name: update_qr_code
tools.description: Change the target URL (or title, or pause/activate) of an existing code. Printed copies keep working and now lead to the new target. Needs the API key of the owner or the edit_url of an anonymous code.

code.description: The short code, e.g. "k7Fq2" (the part after ?c= in the short URL)

active.description: false pauses the code (scanners see a friendly note)

edit_key.description: For codes created without an API key: the edit_url (or its key) returned at creation

tools.name: get_qr_code_stats
tools.description: Scans, daily unique visitors, scans per day, top cities and devices of a code. Anonymous and privacy-friendly (no IPs, no cookies).

code.description: The short code, e.g. "k7Fq2" (the part after ?c= in the short URL)

edit_key.description: For codes created without an API key: the edit_url (or its key) returned at creation

tools.name: list_qr_codes
tools.description: List the codes of the account behind the API key, newest first, with scan counts. Needs an API key.

tools.name: create_qr_codes_bulk
tools.description: Create several codes at once, optionally in a new campaign (e.g. one code per poster location). Needs an API key; the maximum per call depends on the plan.

tools.name: get_limits
tools.description: Shows the current plan (anonymous, free or pro) and its quotas.
